items.html: And behold, three divisions were completed in her: her Yesod, her Malchut, and her Daat, which are the organs of procreation, which are made only from MaH. And upon their return face to face, he gave her, in the first coupling, the name BaN in the aspect of Gadlut, and she was completed. And afterward, in the second coupling, he gave her the MaH, which are the Hasadim, for the sake of the souls.
